events.title: Islam 101: A New Muslims’ Guide
events.description: A New Muslims’ GuideNew Muslims, as well as those interested in learning about Islam, are invited to join this weekly class. It covers the fundamentals of Islam and offers a welcoming space to ask questions and learn in a supportive environment. We warmly welcome people of all faiths to attend. Don't forget to RSVPWhen: Every Thursday 7-8 PMWhere: MCA Youth Lounge

events.title: Unveiling Guidance: A Practical Guide to Living Islam
events.description: Step into a transformative journey with our upcoming community class on Imam al-Ghazali’s The Beginning of Guidance.More than just theory, this class brings faith into your everyday life helping you understand how worship, character, and self-discipline shape not only your actions, but your inner state as a believer.Whether you’re seeking to deepen your connection with Allah, refine your character, or build consistency in your worship, this class offers practical, timeless guidance rooted in one of Islam’s most cherished works.RSVP HereWhen:  Thursdays |  at 8:00 PM (After Maghrib)Where: MCA Khadijah Banquet Hall

events.title: Thursday Suhbah: Pathways to Living Islam
events.description: What if the key to your success was in perfecting your prayer? Join the Dawah & Outreach Committee for Seminary Sundays with Imam Fuad Mohamed, an immersive study of Bulugh al-Maram's Fiqh of Prayer. This program includes guided lessons, materials, and exams to help deepen your understanding of Salah.When:   Every Thursday, starting September 10th | 8:00 PM (after Maghrib Prayer)Where: MCA Khadijah Banquet HallRegister

events.title: Crocheting For Beginners
events.description: Unravel your inner artist and join Jawariya and Shifa Quraishi for a beginner-friendly crochet class designed for sisters ages 7 and up. This 10-week hands-on series will introduce participants to foundational crochet techniques in a welcoming environment, with guided instruction each week to help build confidence and creativity.Registration is $150 for the full series, with $50 from each student registration supporting MCA Women’s Committee programs. Optional supplies are available for purchase for those who need yarn, scissors, and a crochet needle.When:  Fridays Sep 4 - Nov 6 | 4:00 PM - 5:20 PMWhere: MCA Maryam HallRegister

events.title: This is Our Islam: Hispanic Heritage Month
events.description: Join us for a special evening celebrating faith, culture, and community during Hispanic Heritage Month. New Muslims: Bring your family and friends for a meaningful night featuring dinner, a talk in Spanish, a New Muslim panel in english, and an open Q&A.Acompáñanos en una noche especial para celebrar la fe, la cultura y la comunidad durante el Mes de la Herencia Hispana. Nuevos musulmanes: inviten a sus familiares y amigos a disfrutar de una noche significativa con cena, una charla en español, un panel de nuevos musulmanes en inglés y una sesión abierta de preguntas y respuestas.When:  Friday, Oct 2 | 5PM - 10PMWhere: MCA Khadijah Banquet HallRSVP Required

events.title: Free Food Distribution (Sign-Up Required) via Support Life Foundation
events.description: To receive food distributions or volunteer visit - https://supportlives.org/get-yana/

events.title: The Sacred Contract: Fiqh of Public & Penal Law
events.description: How does a society protect its most vulnerable? From the sanctity of blood to the weight of an oath in court, we dive into the Prophetic narrations that built the world’s most enduring legal system. Discover the "why" behind the rulings that govern communal peace, judicial integrity, and the protection of rights.When: Starting Jan 24th  Every Saturday | 10:00 AM - 11:40 AMWhere:  MCA Prayer HallREGISTER HERE

events.title: Camp Iqra Fall ’26
events.description: Join us for Camp Iqra Fall ’26!  A fun and enriching Saturday program featuring Qur’an, Sunnah & Seerah, Sports & Art, and Mentorship & Adab for youth.Ongoing registrationWhen: Sept. 5–Dec. 12, 2026 | 10 AM–2 PMWhere: MCA Youth Lounge & Rizq Halal EatsRegister Now

events.title: Story & Play Time
events.description: The MCA Bookstore, in collaboration with the Women’s Committee, is excited to bring families together every week! Our Story Times are designed to spark a love of reading, strengthen Islamic values, and enrich children’s understanding of their deen in a fun, age-appropriate way. Through stories, songs, and activities, kids develop language, social, and early learning skills.Registration Required

events.title: Youth Boys Basketball
events.description: MCA Youth Boys Basketball is back!Get ready for an exciting season of skill-building, teamwork, and fun on the court! events.title: Sisters Tafsir Class
events.description: Join our weekly tafsir class with AlHuda instructor Sr. Lubna Afzal to study the opening chapters of the Quran. Students will embark on a translation, word-by-word analysis and tafsir that will foster a greater understanding and love for the surahs. Great for busy sisters and beginners!    This weekly tafsir class that will cover translation, word-by-word analysis and tafsir of Surah Fatiha and Surah Baqarah.

events.title: Sisters Beginners Tajweed Class  (Online Only)
events.description: Start your tajweed journey from the basics. Learn essential rules and practice recitation in a beginner-friendly, supportive environment with Dr. Mona Ibrahim.Instructor:Dr. Mona IbrahimWhen: Every Saturday | 1:00–3:00 PMWhere: Online Register Here

events.title: Henna Masterclass
events.description: MCA Women invites girls and women ages 13+ to join a Henna Masterclass with artist Mariyam Afreen. Participants will learn henna design techniques and create intricate patterns in a hands-on class environment.When:  Saturdays Sep 12 - Dec 5 | 2:30 PM to 3:30 PMWhere: MCA Maryam HallRegister

events.title: The Kids’ Tafsir Reading Club
events.description: The Kids' Tafsir Reading Club is open to children ages 7-10, and will meet every other week, on Sundays from 10:30 AM-11:30 AM. We will be using "The Clear Quran-- Tafsir For Kids (Surahs 1-9)" as the primary text. Each session will focus on reading sections from The Clear Quran (Tafsir for Kids), followed by a group discussion, journaling of personal take-aways and learnings, and activities that reinforce the themes and lessons from the reading.    Every other Sunday 10:30AM-11:30AM, starting March 2nd

events.title: Aqeedah 101: Exploring The Essense of Islam
events.description: What if the first step to stronger faith is an unshakeable foundation? Join the Dawah & Outreach Committee for Aqeedah 101 with Imam Fuad Mohamed, an exploration of the essence of Islam through the Qur'an, Sunnah, and the understanding of the early generations. A structured, accessible path to a firm and principled foundation in faith. When:  Sundays, September 13th - November 29th | 11:15 AM - 12:15 PM Where:  MCA Youth LoungeRegister Here

events.title: Introductory Qur’an Reading Class (For Sisters Only)
events.description: This beginner-friendly class is open to sisters with no prior knowledge of Arabic. It aims to help you learn to read the Qur’an correctly in Arabic through step-by-step instruction and guided practice.Instructor: Sr. Lamia AmmarWhen: Every Sunday, Starting June 7 |  12:00 PM – 1:30 PMWhere: MCA Youth LoungeRegister

events.title: Meaningful Conversations w/ Sh. Alauddin
events.description: Meaningful Conversations is a weekly halaqa for high school and college students — a welcoming space to ask questions, reflect, and grow together in faith . Led by Shaykh Alauddin ElBakri, each session is an open, interactive circle designed for honest discussion and meaningful connection.When: Sundays | 5:30PM – 6:30 PMWhere: MCA Youth LoungeRSVP

events.title: Seminary Sundays Adab 102 – High School Diploma
events.description: What if the way you seek knowledge was just as important as the knowledge itself? Join our high school diploma students, alongside Imam Fuad Mohamed, in studying The Tā'iyyah of al-Ilbīrī, a classical poem on the character of the student of knowledge. This course covers The Character of the Student of Knowledge, teaching the sincerity, humility, and discipline every seeker of knowledge needs.When: Sundays, September 13th - November 29th | 6:30 PM - 8:30 PMWhere: MCA Youth LoungeRegister

events.title: Tafseerah: Professionals Halaqa
events.description: Tafseerah is a unique summer halaqa series for professionals and adults, exploring the Qur'an in the order it was revealed to the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ .  Led by Shaykh Alauddin ElBakri, each session uncovers the spiritual, historical, and social context of revelation in an engaging and reflective setting. Refreshments providedWhen: Sundays | 7PM – 8:30 PMWhere: MCA Youth LoungeRSVP

events.title: Brothers Tajweed Class at MCA
events.description: The MCA Dawah & Outreach Committee is excited to present a Beginner’s Tajweed Class for Brothers, offering a foundational understanding of Tajweed rules to improve Quranic recitation. For more details, contact us at dawah@mcabayarea.org.
